name: com.byjg/docs
title: ByJG Open Source Docs
description: Search the ByJG open source documentation: PHP, DevOps, Helm, JavaScript and AI projects.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the ByJG open source documentation and return the most relevant passages, each with its public URL. Combines semantic and keyword matching, so both natural-language questions ('how do I map a table to a class') and exact symbol names ('TableAttribute') work. Optionally narrow to a category (php, devops, js, ai, helm) or a project (micro-orm, restserver, docker-easy-haproxy, ...).

query.description: A natural-language question or an exact symbol name.
query.title: Query

limit.description: Maximum passages to return; 0 uses the server default. Capped by the server.
limit.title: Limit

category.description: Restrict to one category: php, devops, js, ai or helm.
category.title: Category

project.description: Restrict to one project, as named by list_projects (e.g. micro-orm).
project.title: Project

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Return the full markdown of one documentation page, addressed by the `source` path reported in a search result (for example `php/micro-orm/active-record.md`). Use it when a search hit is relevant but truncated and you need the whole page.

source_path.description: The `source` value from a search_docs result, e.g. php/micro-orm/active-record.md.
source_path.title: Source Path

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Inventory of everything indexed, grouped by category and project, with document and passage counts. Use it to discover which ByJG libraries have documentation before searching.
